transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

Thanks. Well, what brought me in is... I just don't really feel like myself anymore. I barely talk to people lately. I just kind of go flat and quiet. And even at work... I do building cleaning, and just getting started on my cleaning route feels like pushing a loaded cart uphill. I just can't seem to get going.
About how long have you been feeling this way?
Well, the depression part of it has been with me for about a year and two months now. It started up not too long after I moved.
Before this started a year ago, had you ever experienced a period of depression like this in your life?
No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had days where I felt a bit down or tired, like anyone else, but... nothing like this. This is the first time it's been this heavy, or lasted this long.
Have you ever had a time in your life when you felt unusually high, energized, or on top of the world for several days in a row?

No, I can't say that I have. I've never really felt like that... unusually high or energized. I've always just been kind of a regular, steady guy, at least until all this started. So, no, nothing like what you're describing.
Have you ever heard voices or other sounds that other people around you couldn't hear?

Yeah, actually, I have. Um... when I’m mopping at work after hours, I’ll hear a man’s voice. He'll say my name, or... or tell me I’ve missed a spot. It sounds real clear, like he’s just standing right there by the stairwell. But when I stop and look over, there’s nobody there.
When did you first start hearing that voice?
It’s been going on for about 11 months now. That voice, and... well, also these worries I've been having about being watched. They both started up around the same time, about 11 months ago.
Over the past 11 months while hearing the voice, has there ever been a time when your depression completely lifted, even for a couple of weeks?

Well, there was a stretch of several weeks where my mood did lift some. I was getting through my meals and, you know, handling my work a little better during that time. But... even then, I still heard my name being called in the stairwell. And I stayed convinced that the hallway cameras were being used to track me. So the mood got a bit better for a few weeks, but those other things didn't stop.
Over this past year, have you completely lost interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy?

Yeah, I really have. I used to look forward to things, you know? Like going fishing on Saturdays, or just sitting down to do crosswords with my coffee. Even at work, I liked showing the younger guys some tricks for stripping a floor... but now, I mostly just let all those things sit. I don't bother with them because they just don't give me anything back anymore. There's just no enjoyment in it.

Like I was saying a minute ago... yeah, for those few weeks, my mood really did lift. That heavy feeling went away, and I was eating regular meals and getting through my shifts at work a lot easier. But... well, the other stuff didn't stop. I still heard my name echoing out in the stairwell, and I was still dead set that those hallway cameras were tracking me. So the sadness took a break, but the rest of it didn't.
